# title

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:title`](gmeow-title.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/title>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The flat title literal of a creative work — the 80%-case shortcut for a single plain title. Promote to a structured [`gmeow:CreativeWorkTitle`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWorkTitle.md) via [`gmeow:hasTitle`](gmeow-hasTitle.md) when language, script, evidence, or co-equal multilingual titles must be first-class.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:title`](gmeow-title.md) from [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) to [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the 80% case of a single plain title on a creative work — the flat literal shortcut when no language, script, or statement-level title metadata is needed.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it when co-equal multilingual titles, scripts, or supersession must be modelled — promote to a structured [`gmeow:CreativeWorkTitle`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWorkTitle.md) linked by [`gmeow:hasTitle`](gmeow-hasTitle.md).

### How to use

- Carry the title string on [`gmeow:title`](gmeow-title.md); when richer metadata is later needed, mint [`gmeow:CreativeWorkTitle`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWorkTitle.md) objects and link them via [`gmeow:hasTitle`](gmeow-hasTitle.md) (the flat/reified pair).

### Examples

- ex:work [`gmeow:title`](gmeow-title.md) "Moby-Dick".
